title: Phase boundaries: d = 2, 3, 4, 5
caption: Unconnected MC extrapolations versus the full tree instability criterion (2d-1)v1=1. Dark bars: conditional MC95. Pale bars: descriptive sensitivity unions, not certified total confidence intervals. Beta=0 endpoints have horizontal bars; fixed-epsilon points have vertical bars. The open d=5 square at epsilon/pi=1 is a rejected-fit diagnostic, not an accepted critical coupling. Axes differ across panels.

title: Finite-size transition fits: d = 3
caption: Binder U=1/4 pseudo-critical locations, plotted against N^(-1/nu), nu=0.67169. Interpolation, size cuts and correction fits are sensitivity assumptions. This is the phase-boundary analysis, not the later common-xi scaling-dimension estimator.

title: Finite-size transition fits: d = 4
caption: Binder U=1/4 locations use the leading N^-2 (ln N)^(-1/10) shift coordinate. Uniform primary positive-beta cut N>=10 was chosen after inspecting pilot residuals. Fits and error coverage remain conditional.

title: Finite-size transition diagnostics: d = 5
caption: Dedicated above-upper-critical-dimension leading N^-5/2 shift, with additive N^-3 stress tests. Quarter-Binder is a fixed ordered-side criterion, not a universal finite-box critical value. Rejected fits and zero-degree-of-freedom diagnostics must not be presented as validated extrapolations.

title: 3D beta=0: four sizes on one plot
caption: Measured xi/L for L=24,32,48,64 with independent broad-window quadratic response fits. No common crossing or critical xi/L is imposed. Bars/bands are conditional MC95. Finite-size curves need not cross at exactly one epsilon.

title: 3D beta=0: reading off the spin dimension
caption: At the exactly sampled epsilon/pi=0.80075, RMS magnetization scales approximately as L^-Delta_eff over L=24,32,48,64. Correlated fit gives Delta_eff=0.51942 +/- 0.00795 statistical SD. This is a representative fixed-epsilon finite-size slope, not a calibrated infinite-volume CFT result.

title: 3D beta=0: effective dimensions across the scan
caption: Delta_eff(L,2L;q)=-ln(<m2>_2L/<m2>_L)/(2 ln2), evaluated at common q. Four overlapping size pairs retain shared-source covariance. Grey band is a descriptive union of finite-pair xi/L crossing intervals, not a thermodynamic epsilon_c confidence interval.

title: 3D beta=0: conditional size extrapolations
caption: Correlated extrapolations of common-xi quotient dimensions with fixed Wilson-Fisher-informed correction exponent omega=0.789. These illustrate model and size-cut sensitivity; no final Delta +/- stat +/- sys is established. Low/missing-validity pairs are not silently accepted.

title: 3D beta=0: analysis sensitivity
caption: Local response model/window, late-cut, block-length and independent-start sensitivity. A stable selected family is not proof of complete mixing or total uncertainty coverage; rejected responses and unresolved alternatives are retained in the source analysis.
